description:
It's fair to say not many new signings, if any, have had quite as good a first season for a club as Erling Haaland has this season for Man City. This feature documents his first year in blue, from signing in June 2022 to lifting the UEFA Champions League trophy in June 2023 to cap a remarkable treble winning season.
